mainText: Hello, Verona! At 10 AM, here is today's balanced dish: we have 74 degrees and dense drizzle outside the Verona Public Library with a moderate air quality index of 62.
The City of Verona Plan Commission is meeting on September 8th to discuss site plans for 201 South Main Street and initial reviews for projects like Sub-Zero in the Liberty Business Park.

There is plenty to do with trivia at Hop Haus and Lake Lou-ee today. Tomorrow, be sure to catch the Downtown Farmers Market at Hometown Junction Park or join in on trivia at The Mill and The Bogey Factory.
In a report from last Saturday, Verona police assisted the Dane County Sheriff's Office following a vehicle rollover crash where the driver fled the scene and was eventually arrested for O W I.
Today is the perfect day for some Chocolate Heath Crunch at Culvers. They are open until 10 PM tonight, so you have plenty of time to stop by for a sweet snack.
